rationale: Existing coverage is split across two specs: dashboard-create-alert.spec.js (Dashboards) covers the single-query panel -> straight-to-form path (Workflow 1) and the chart right-click threshold context menu (Workflow 4); metrics-promql-formula.spec.js (Metrics) proves the multi-stream PromQL formula -> stream picker (Workflow 3, lines 143-156). The headline behavior of THIS feature — the multi-query panel opening the shared confirm dialog in pickQueryOnly mode (query picker + picked-query, with threshold/window/preview hidden), plus the disabled menu item, cancel, and blocking-warning states — is covered nowhere. That confirm-dialog surface is alert-creation machinery (CreateAlertFromSourceDialog/query picker) and belongs in the Alerts area, matching run-context spec_path and playwright_group. Create a new Alerts spec rather than folding alert-dialog tests into a Dashboards shard; note the already-covered chart-right-click and single-query paths in the plan so they are NOT duplicated.
